Package dev.gmitch215.bytebox.security

Class MessageDigest

java.lang.Object
dev.gmitch215.bytebox.security.MessageDigest
public final class MessageDigest extends Object
java.security.MessageDigest, which the class library does not carry, for MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512.

Written in Java rather than backed by SubtleCrypto.digest, because that returns a promise and a substituted class cannot suspend. SHA-224, SHA-512/256, SHA-3 and the MD2 digest are not provided; asking for them throws NoSuchAlgorithmException the way an unknown name does on a JVM. Providers are not modelled: there is no getInstance(String, String) and no getProvider, and no clone.

Since:
1.0.3
